text: {"name":"hci_acl_tx_done","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Finalizes an HCI ACL transmission by updating its descriptor and per-link transmit state, conditionally queuing a status message, and checking RF temperature.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"tx_descriptor","v2":"per_link_tx_state","v6":"link_env","v7":"tx_buffer","v12":"tx_count","v14":"remaining_tx_count","v15":"calibration_value","v18":"link_id"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":107,"meaning":"Link index used to select per-link state and included in the queued message."},{"offset":192,"meaning":"Pointer to the transmit descriptor being updated."},{"offset":227,"meaning":"Transmit countdown copied into per-link state and decremented."},{"offset":230,"meaning":"Transmit status bits that affect the per-link flag and returned status."},{"offset":231,"meaning":"Counter decremented during completion processing and used for packet updates and message handling."},{"offset":232,"meaning":"Byte offset in the transmit buffer where the remaining count is written."},{"offset":233,"meaning":"Optional second byte offset in the transmit buffer where the remaining count is written."}]}
